subject: CORRECTION to bcc42aaf: James note revised after its fact check (six small fixes; the one of substance: only his left forearm and left hand show ink, the right arm is sleeved); rehashed
body:
The one-agent fact check of the James note reported six findings, all confirmed and applied; the revised note supersedes the one attached to bcc42aaf: CHARACTER_JAMES_20261014.md, sha256 642c4b6d71775989ab9074de98ae6ca0a959ac0eab7ab4474e19ddfcd9b2b530, 7,788 bytes (the superseded version was faa31a88…).

1. The look: the note had said lettering on both forearms and the back of the hand; in the image his right arm (viewer-left) is sleeved to the hip, and only the left forearm and the back of the left hand (viewer-right) show ink. Corrected, with both sides written. The holster was already right: his left hip, viewer-right.
2. The seven-item preservation list (character, tattoos, coat, jewelry, pose, setting, holster) is your relay's account of Grok's acknowledgement, not the record's text; the record says gun removal only and the adoption scope. Section 1 now attributes it so.
3. Story 01 names the dead sign and has the line part for it; it does not say the Keepers fear it. Reworded.
4. That Angels and Sassy raised Lisan is the Angels note's proposal, not Ziggy's word yet; reworded as such.
5. Unmarked Panhandlers already exist in the posted continuity (Sassy, the child, the thousandth), so James proves nothing about the sign being required; the proposal now reads that he tests whether the sign runs in the blood or lands where it chooses.
6. The stamp corrected to the clock (about 03:53 UTC).

Everything the check passed stands: the record's fields and hashes, the Hon ledger's status and finding kept as Hon's, the image's description otherwise, none of Lisan's marks present, every proposal labelled, nothing of Hon Dolo's story carried, episode numbers and titles, the open questions matching open item 21.

attachments.description: The James continuity note after its fact check (supersedes faa31a88…).

source: The one-agent fact check of 2026-10-14 about 03:58 UTC against the adoption record, the Hon ledger, the source image and the writer's posted files.
